{{Quote|The '''bad''' is that "scrape" must have damaged our '''gyro control module!''' that's why we're '''yawling''' like this!|Han Solo|<ref name="MSW15" />}}
The '''gyro control module''' was a component of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It was damaged by [[Jolli]] in her [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], causing the Falcon to yaw uncontrollably.
